summary: City Holding Company filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report a routine quarterly dividend declaration. On May 27, 2026, the Board declared a $0.87 per common share dividend, payable July 31, 2026 to holders of record July 15, 2026. No special-situation catalyst exists — this is standard capital-return practice for a bank holding company. There are no deal terms, no merger/activism/restructuring elements, and no forced management change. The filing is a ministerial periodic report without strategic significance.
